description: Have your bot respond with Cleverbot-style conversation responses, with configurable response tweaks.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration, response tweaks, and optional allowlist/blocklist IDs for channels, categories, roles, and users. It also passes user message content to an external API for simulated conversation responses.
install_msg: Set an API key with `[p]cleverbotset apikey` or `[p]cleverbotset ioapikey`, then use `[p]cleverbot <text>` or mention the bot to talk with Cleverbot. Use `[p]cleverbotset toggle` to toggle mention replies.
name: Cleverbot
